text:
dina (partnerships): Quick heads-up — SkyForge asked to onboard a gov-compliant regional offering called "Coda" next week. Need quota approvals, KMS entitlements, and a legal dataflow signoff. Who can own quota requests?

matt (infra-ops): I can kick off quota requests for GCP/Azure. Need exact vGPU types + expected QPS.

dina (partnerships): Thanks — they want 16xA100 equivalent for initial pool, target 200 qps steady, 600 burst. Also need KMS integration for customer keys and a marketplace listing date.

raja (solutions): For SI bits, FogWorks will handle connector testing — pinged their SRE. Timeline OK if infra has quota before Tue EOD.

matt (infra-ops): Copy. I'll create quota tickets. Command I use for tracking: ```gcloud compute regions quotas request --region=coda-region --accelerator=A100 --count=16 --notes="Redwood - SkyForge launch"```

ops-bot: Ticket created #SF-46902 for Azure quota request, #SF-46903 for GCP quota. Assigned to matt. :white_check_mark:

jules (product): Marketplace listing needs legal + marketing review. Proposed announcement window: 2 weeks from quota approval. Is that still realistic?

sophia (legal): I'll review the dataflow and KMS integration doc today. Two items to watch: key custody model (customer-managed vs. Redwood) and logging retention in gov regions.

dina (partnerships): Sophia — can you confirm whether customer-managed keys will require any extra compliance artifacts from the partner?

sophia (legal): Likely an HSM attestation and updated DPA clause. I'll draft a short checklist and post in this thread.

matt (infra-ops): Quick note: Azure requires a quota escalation form plus a support plan on file. I've attached the escalation URL in the ticket and requested a PR to raise support tier.

raja (solutions): FogWorks SRE asked for an allowlist CIDR for connector tests. Can we provide a temporary egress IP range?

matt (infra-ops): I'll reserve an ephemeral IP block and add to the ticket: 34.200.120.0/24.

dina (partnerships): Action items summary: matt -> quota tickets + ephemeral IP; sophia -> legal checklist; raja -> coordinate FogWorks testing; jules -> lock marketplace assets pending legal. Can each confirm?

matt (infra-ops): Confirmed. ETA for quota approvals: 48-72h once support plan is updated.

raja (solutions): Confirmed — will schedule FogWorks test window for Thu-Fri.

sophia (legal): Confirmed — checklist incoming in ~3h.

jules (product): Confirmed. I'll prep the marketplace slug and hero assets and hold until legal clearance.

dina (partnerships): Great. If anyone hits blockers tag @dina and I'll escalate to SkyForge PM. Also linking runbook we should follow: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/partner-onboard-coda (internal).

ops-bot: Reminder set — follow-up in 48 hours on SF-46902/46903.
